lines.text: The LORD says a man cannot hide in secret places, because He fills the heavens and the earth.
The prophets say "I had a dream!" hoping the people will forget His name, as their fathers did through Baal worship.
The LORD says His word is like fire and a hammer, and He opposes prophets who steal words from one another.
The LORD says He sent the prophets of false dreams, yet they lead His people astray and bring no benefit.

wrong_details.wrong: He sent the prophets of false dreams
wrong_details.true: It was not I who sent them or commanded them

lines.text: The LORD says that anyone who claims "the burden of the LORD" will be punished, then forgotten and cast out, and Jerusalem will be spared.

wrong_details.true: He will cast out both them and the city He gave to them and their fathers
